result.topic_en: For a plane elastic surface deformed by forces, with the natural length of a line element written as a quadratic form in dx and dy, Gauss states differential conditions on the coefficients p, q, r and, in terms of the undeformed coordinates ξ, η as functions of the deformed coordinates x, y, two second-order partial differential equations.
result.transcription:
Wenn in einer elastischen durch Kräfte veränderten
ebnen fläche $ds$ die natürliche Länge eines Elements
$= \sqrt{[(1+p)dx^2 + 2q\,dx\,dy + {+(1+}r)dy^2]}$
so ist
$\frac{d([-p-]{+p+} + 3r)}{dx} - \frac{2dq}{dy} = 0$
$\frac{d(p + [-?-]{+r+}[?])}{dy} - \frac{2dq}{dx} = 0$
Entsprechen also Einem und demselben Punkte
im ungeänderten Zustande die Coordinaten $\xi, \eta$
im geänderten $x, y$
so ist
I $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac{d\xi}{dx}\left(\frac{dd\xi}{dx^2} - \frac{dd\xi}{dy^2}\right) + \frac{2d\xi}{dy}\cdot\frac{dd\xi}{dx.dy} \\ + \frac{d\eta}{dx}\left(\frac{dd\eta}{dx^2} - \frac{dd\eta}{dy^2}\right) + \frac{2d\eta}{dy}\cdot\frac{dd\eta}{dx.dy} \end{array}\right\} = 0$
II $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac{d\xi}{dy}\left(\frac{dd\xi}{dx^2} - \frac{dd\xi}{dy^2}\right) - \frac{2d\xi}{dx}\cdot\frac{dd\xi}{dx.dy} \\ + \frac{d\eta}{dy}\left(\frac{dd\eta}{dx^2} - \frac{dd\eta}{dy^2}\right) - \frac{2d\eta}{dx}\cdot\frac{dd\eta}{dx.dy} \end{array}\right\} = 0$

methods.what: Natural (undeformed) length of a line element of a deformed elastic plane written as a quadratic form (metric) in the deformed coordinates
First-order differential conditions on the strain coefficients p, q, r
Second differential condition on the strain coefficients p, q, r
Equivalent second-order PDE (I) for the undeformed coordinates ξ, η as functions of the deformed coordinates x, y
Equivalent second-order PDE (II) for ξ, η as functions of x, y
